articles.title: BTS Fakes a Tabloid Scandal—in a Bathroom—to Tease New Single
articles.summary: BTS ran fake tabloid-style newspaper ads showing all seven members at urinals, sparking curiosity for their single "NORMAL." The track drops Friday on Spotify, with a video exploring life between fame and ordinary moments.

articles.title: Space Balls: Australian Beachgoers Stumble Upon Rocket Debris from Orbit
articles.summary: Six pressurized fuel vessels, or "space balls," from an unidentified spacecraft washed ashore in Queensland, Australia. The Australian Space Agency confirmed they survived re-entry and are common debris.

articles.title: Former PlayStation CEO Wants Xbox to 'Get Some of Its Mojo Back'
articles.summary: Shawn Layden, ex-Sony Interactive Entertainment America CEO, expressed nostalgia for the fierce Xbox-PlayStation rivalry, saying it drove innovation. His comments come as Xbox lays off 3,200 workers amid restructuring.
